comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: is this related to #5530 ? it has SAI errors.

comments.author: gechiang
comments.body:
I was able to reproduce this with Both 
BRCM SAI ver: [4.2.1.3], OCP SAI ver: [1.6.5], SDK ver: [sdk-6.5.19] and
BRCM SAI ver: [3.7.5.1], OCP SAI ver: [1.6.3], SDK ver: [6.5.16] CANCUN ver: [5.3.3]
The HW SKU that we have tried one is TH based one is TD3 based and both behaved the same way with the above versions of SAI code.

The cause of the crash was due to setting SAI_TUNNEL_DSCP_MODE_PIPE_MODEL was not supported by SAI:
```
Oct 14 18:45:35.129763 str2-dx010-acs-6 ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: VID: oid:0x2a0000000005f5 RID: oid:0x2a00000002
Oct 14 18:45:35.129763 str2-dx010-acs-6 ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_DSCP_MODE: SAI_TUNNEL_DSCP_MODE_PIPE_MODEL
Oct 14 18:45:35.129763 str2-dx010-acs-6 ERR syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: failed to execute api: set, key: SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_TUNNEL:oid:0x2a0000000005f5, status: SAI_STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
Oct 14 18:45:35.131129 str2-dx010-acs-6 ERR syncd#syncd: :- run: Runtime error: :- processQuadEvent: failed to execute api: set, key: SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_TUNNEL:oid:0x2a0000000005f5, status: SAI_STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
Oct 14 18:45:35.131129 str2-dx010-acs-6 NOTICE syncd#syncd: :- sendShutdownRequest: sending switch_shutdown_request notification to OA for switch: oid:0x21000000000000
'```

But with  SAI version:
BRCM SAI ver: [3.7.5.2], OCP SAI ver: [1.5.2], SDK ver: [6.5.16] CANCUN ver: [5.3.3]
We did not see this issue on the same DUTs running the same test case trigger.


Filed a case with BRCM to start the investigation...

comments.author: prsunny
comments.body:
The root-cause is some of the attributes were create_only and it is recently changed to create_and_set ([PR](https://github.com/opencomputeproject/SAI/pull/1086/files)). Originally sai library returned the following error in 201911 and the orchagent bypassed it.

`orchagent: :- meta_generic_validation_set: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_DSCP_MODE:SAI_ATTR_VALUE_TYPE_INT32 attr is create only and cannot be modified`

whereas now (master), it sets the value to SAI and it returns "Not implemented" resulting in crash.

```
syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: attr: SAI_TUNNEL_ATTR_DECAP_DSCP_MODE: SAI_TUNNEL_DSCP_MODE_PIPE_MODEL
syncd#syncd: :- processQuadEvent: failed to execute api: set, key: SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_TUNNEL:oid:0x2a000000000629, status: SAI_STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
```

So, in all versions of BCM SAI, the set was never implemented.
